##### Project general facts

Costa Mare is a striking waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, composed of four architecturally distinctive towers that harmonize with their natural surroundings. The design draws inspiration from both the sea and the nearby mountains, expressed through fluid forms, soft earthy tones, and expansive glazing that captures panoramic views. Each residence is thoughtfully planned to maximize light, space, and tranquility, creating a refined coastal environment that balances elegance with a sense of calm exclusivity.

The lifestyle at Costa Mare is defined by a rich collection of resort-style amenities designed for both relaxation and activity. Residents enjoy direct access to a private beach, multiple infinity pools, and beautifully landscaped communal areas that encourage connection and leisure. Fitness studios, jogging tracks, and a padel court support an active lifestyle, while families benefit from dedicated kids’ play areas and clubhouses. Additional features such as a private cinema, wellness studio, and curated dining spaces further elevate the everyday living experience.

Interiors at Costa Mare are finished with modern design and high-quality materials, creating sophisticated yet comfortable living spaces. Equipped kitchens are seamlessly integrated, offering both practicality and clean aesthetics. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while enjoying a premium foundation of contemporary finishes and refined craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
